    Setting for Bongartz's "On mild contours" #

    MildHyp k P: a finite ray category with cancellation all of whose proper residues P/τ (τ nonzero, non-invertible) have representation-finite linearization. Thin cleaving diagrams into a residue then give contradictions (MildHyp.not_thin_cleaving). The ray category of a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra satisfies MildHyp (SplitBasicData.mildHyp, via B5).
